title: Routine Spin
reference: F1 F1 F1 def F1 { forward jump forward }
hints: Each side is the same: step, jump, step onto a turntable.
Teach F1 one side, then call it three times.
F1 F1 F1 def F1 { forward jump forward }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Silk Loom. The weaving bots here run one routine over and over. Teach it once, call it by name."
